doubts.claim_under_doubt: The two TOCTOU vanish-windows already guarded (existsSync-to-lstat, and post-lock-acquire re-check) close every gap where the register file can disappear mid-request.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Read proper-lockfile's actual source: with realpath:true (the default here), lockfile.lock() calls fs.realpath(file) FIRST, before this code's own post-acquire guardExistingTarget re-check ever runs. A THIRD vanish-window exists strictly between checkRegisterReachable's pass and the lock() call itself -- if the register (a file with a real second writer, leadwright's own daemon) disappears there, proper-lockfile's realpath rejects with ENOENT, which the route handler's catch block (recognizing only OrgSymlinkEscapeError, BeatRegisterInvalidError, and code==="ELOCKED") did not handle, falling through to an uncaught 500 instead of the graceful 404 the other two windows already produce. Confirmed genuine by reading server/node_modules/proper-lockfile/lib/lockfile.js directly, and reproduced empirically via `node -e` against a real deleted file.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Wrap the lockfile.lock() call in its own try/catch mapping ENOENT to {ok:false, reason:"not-found"}, rethrowing everything else (including ELOCKED) unchanged. Fixed and regression-tested (beat-register-release-guards.test.ts, mocking proper-lockfile's lock() via vi.mock to reject with ENOENT for one call -- ESM module namespaces can't be vi.spyOn'd directly).

doubts.claim_under_doubt: sessionId validation (UUID_RE) and register entry matching agree on what counts as the same session.
doubts.disproof_attempt: UUID_RE used the case-insensitive /i flag, so an uppercase-but-otherwise-valid UUID passes validation. Entry matching in beat-register-release-core.ts (`e.sessionId === sessionId`) is an exact, unnormalized string comparison. leadwright's writer always produces crypto.randomUUID(), which is lowercase by definition, so a differently-cased input that passes validation can never match the real (lowercase) entry -- it silently returns 404 not-found for a session that genuinely has an open beat.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Remove the /i flag so a differently-cased input is rejected up front as 400 sessionId_invalid rather than silently mismatching downstream. Fixed and regression-tested.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Fixing the lock()-ENOENT vanish-window closes every risk in that window.
doubts.disproof_attempt: A symlink-swap during the same pre-lock window could make lockfile.lock() briefly lock an attacker-chosen realpath, creating a transient stray lock directory before the subsequent postGuard rejects it as a symlink. This is a genuine residual gap, not fully closed by the ENOENT fix.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Disclosed, not fixed -- assessed as within the already-accepted local-machine/Tailscale threat model this host+secret-gated route family operates under (single-operator machine, not a multi-tenant server). Flagged for the record only.
